# gyro_backup_space (Data Source)

Connection details, usage and state of an existing Gyro Backup Space (GET /cloud/backup-spaces/{id}). The password is not exposed here; use the gyro_backup_space resource (sensitive password) or `gyro backup-space credentials <id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Connection details and usage of an existing backup space (no password).
data "gyro_backup_space" "yedek" {
  id = 12345
}

output "backup_used_percent" {
  value = data.gyro_backup_space.yedek.used_percent
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Backup space (service) id.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_ips` (List of String)
- `cycle` (String)
- `due_date` (String)
- `host` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `path` (String)
- `plan` (String) Size plan, e.g. 100gb.
- `port` (Number)
- `server_id` (Number) Bound server (null = none).
- `size_gb` (Number)
- `state` (String) pending, active, noserver, suspended, cancelled, purged.
- `status` (String) Service status.
- `used_bytes` (Number) Used space (null when it could not be measured).
- `used_percent` (Number)
- `user` (String)
